en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal promenade lined with trees and classical buildings. A man walks along the path in the left foreground, while the right side shows a row of waterfront houses and a prominent larger building facing the water. The scene is calm and urban, with the canal curving into the distance. Printed at the top are the words indicating the location.
